title: Beautiful 2 Bedroom corner Condo With Rooftop
description:
Welcome to Nashville!!  Two bedroom corner home with rooftop deck.  10 Minutes away from  BNA airport, Opryland, The Grand Old Opry and the famous downtown Broadway.  This home has 2 bedrooms/2.5 baths with extra sleeping space on the queen size sleeper sofa.  Minutes from restaurants and shopping.

The space
The kitchen opens up into the living room with a small four person table with chairs.  There are four bar chairs at the countertop in the kitchen.  The second floor is the master bedroom with your own en-suite bathroom and the second bedroom with a full bathroom right outside the door.  The top floor is the rooftop with a fire pit with seating for four along with a table with an umbrella for shade and chairs for four too

Guest access
You will have the whole condo to yourself
